questions.cardDe: Welches Land befindet sich nicht in Südamerika: Guyana, Lesotho oder Suriname?
questions.de: Auf welchem Kontinent liegt der Staat Lesotho?
questions.en: On which continent is the country of Lesotho located?

timeline.labelEn: Basutoland becomes independent from the United Kingdom as the Kingdom of Lesotho
timeline.labelDe: Basutoland wird als Königreich Lesotho vom Vereinigten Königreich unabhängig

questions.notes: Card answer: Lesotho (an enclave in southern Africa, entirely surrounded by South Africa); Guyana and Suriname are in South America.

questions.en: Which bird has the largest brain relative to its body size?

timeline.labelEn: Nicholas Aylward Vigors introduces the hummingbird family Trochilidae
timeline.labelDe: Nicholas Aylward Vigors führt die Familie der Kolibris (Trochilidae) ein

source.title: What Makes Hummingbirds Special – Gulf Coast Bird Observatory

questions.notes: Popular figure: brain about 4.2% of body weight, the largest brain-to-body proportion of any bird. Scientific comparisons (encephalization relative to allometric expectation) usually point to parrots and corvids instead. Timeline date from en.wikipedia 'Hummingbird'.

questions.cardDe: Was gibt es beim Nähen nicht: Blindstich, Hexenstich oder Adelsstich?
questions.de: Wie heißt der dehnbare Saum- und Zierstich mit sich schräg überkreuzenden Fäden, der auch Fischgrätenstich genannt wird?
questions.en: What is the German name of the stretchy hemming and decorative stitch with diagonally crossing threads, also called the herringbone stitch?

timeline.labelEn: Thérèse de Dillmont's Encyclopedia of Needlework, a classic reference for stitches like the herringbone stitch, first appears
timeline.labelDe: Thérèse de Dillmonts Enzyklopädie der Handarbeiten, ein Standardwerk auch zum Hexenstich, erscheint erstmals

questions.notes: Card answer: 'Adelsstich' does not exist; Blindstich and Hexenstich both do. The Hexenstich has many other names (Fangstich, Flechtstich, Kreuznaht, Perserstich …); it has a long history but no datable origin, so the timeline uses Dillmont's encyclopedia (cited by the de.wikipedia article; first published from 1886 per de.wikipedia 'Thérèse de Dillmont').
